prose: Business Insider reports a public feud between coding-agent startups Factory and Cognition. Factory CEO Matan Grinberg says he fired Chris Degnan, alleging Degnan shared confidences with Cognition executives while advising Factory, before joining Cognition as chief revenue officer. Based on the Techmeme excerpt; the article was not retrieved.
highlights: Factory CEO says he terminated Chris Degnan
Alleges Degnan confided with Cognition execs while advising Factory
Degnan then joined Cognition as CRO
Both firms build coding agents and are San Francisco based
Allegations as reported, not verified here
